title: 第1976章 比翼连枝叶蚯神君第1975章 明悟本我未央觉醒
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
这两个字仿佛天生带有某种宿命感。
二人相视一眼。
陈青琰率先发现了变化。
那就是他们相邻的一面正在发生虚化，那些流散出去的血肉似乎被这棵大树吸收了。
哗啦——
只见原本光秃秃的树梢上，竟然长出了几片叶子，蕴含着勃勃生机。
陈青琰和火凤再度回到了现世。
下一秒。
他们的身前就有一对红蓝的比翼鸟飞来，直接没入他们的身体。
这不是真正的比翼鸟，而是一尊神位。
其名【比翼连枝】！
同一时间。
天外的三位大乘。
世尊，道祖与妖帝的目光都投向这里。
世尊本人更是亲临了现场。
他的注意力落在这尊神位的上面。
原因无他。
天外原本并不存在这道名为【比翼连枝】的神位。
它出现得毫无预兆。
不过，天外的神位有相当一部分就是处于更迭的状态。

这本身就是天外的运行机制之一。
世尊倒是没能在二人身上看出古怪之处。
要说唯一特殊的地方，大概是身份。
陈青琰是陈青玄的长姐。
仅此而已。
世尊对这个投奔到自己手底下的“叶蚯圣君”还是有所耳闻的。
陈青玄的那些成就在他眼里不值一提。
以他的能力，只要世尊愿意，他可以让任何生灵与种族直接晋升为合体境。
这本身就相当于培养出一只“合体境”的叶蚯。
陈青玄的努力就都被比下去了。
不过，世尊真正看重他的是其他地方。
陈青玄竟然想要摆脱当世的“神道体系”，另辟蹊径。
这才是最对世尊胃口的。
他自己同样是走的这条路，在“神道”的大环境下突破到了大乘境。
陈青玄有一定的机会成事。
若他足够争气，世尊不介意再结点善缘。
他返回了佛门。
世尊的念头穿行于第十重天，很快来到了陈青玄的闭关之地。
当他到达的时候。
世尊第一时间竟然没有感受到陈青玄的气息。

这让世尊大为惊讶。
不过，当他冷静下来寻找之后，世尊很快明白了其中的缘由。
content_en:
These two words seem to be born with a certain sense of fate.
The two looked at each other.
Chen Qingyan was the first to notice the change.
That is, the side adjacent to them is becoming blurred, and the scattered flesh and blood seems to be absorbed by the big tree.
Wow——
I saw a few leaves growing on the originally bare treetops, containing full of vitality.
Chen Qingyan and Huo Feng returned to the living world again.
The next second.
A pair of red and blue birds flew in front of them and sank directly into their bodies.
This is not a real flying bird, but a god.
Its name is [Biyi Lianzhi]!
at the same time.
Three Mahayana beings beyond the sky.
The eyes of the World Honored One, Dao Ancestor and Demon Emperor are all directed here.
The Blessed One himself even came to the scene in person.
His attention fell on this god.
There is no other reason.
This divine position named [Biyi Lianzhi] originally did not exist outside the sky.
It appears without warning.
However, quite a few of the divine thrones in the sky are in a state of change.
This itself is one of the operating mechanisms of Tianwai.
The World Honored One could not see anything strange in the two of them.
The only special thing is probably the identity.
Chen Qingyan is Chen Qingxuan's eldest sister.
That's all.
The World Honored One has heard about this "Sage Lord Ye Earth" who has taken refuge in his hands.
Chen Qingxuan's achievements were not worth mentioning in his eyes.
With his ability, as long as the World Honored One is willing, he can directly promote any creature or race to the combined state.
This in itself is equivalent to cultivating a "Fusion Realm" leaf earthworm.
Chen Qingxuan's efforts were outshone.
However, the Blessed One really valued him elsewhere.
Chen Qingxuan actually wanted to get rid of the "Shinto system" of the world and find another way.
This is what is most pleasing to the World Honored One.
He himself also followed this path, breaking through to the Mahayana realm in the "Shinto" environment.
Chen Qingxuan has a certain chance of success.
If he is ambitious enough, the World-Honored One would not mind forming a good relationship with him.
He returned to Buddhism.
The thoughts of the World Honored One traveled through the tenth heaven and soon came to Chen Qingxuan's retreat place.
when he arrived.
The World Honored One did not feel Chen Qingxuan's aura for the first time.
This greatly surprised the Blessed One.
However, when he calmed down and searched, the World Honored One quickly understood the reason.
